name: Wellington
tagline: Windy, creative capital with Te Papa and craft coffee
summary: Wellington is New Zealand's compact capital, wrapped around a harbour, with a red cable car, the superb national museum Te Papa and a famous café and craft beer scene. It is also the home of the film studios behind The Lord of the Rings and the ferry port to the South Island.
seasonNote: Summer is mild; it is windy all year, so bring a jacket.
arrival: Wellington Airport is 15 minutes from the centre by Airport Express bus.
gettingAround: Walk the waterfront; buses and the cable car.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; carry a little cash for rural honesty boxes.
foodTip: Flat whites, craft beer and Wellington on a Plate dishes.
baseArea: Te Aro, Cuba Street or the waterfront
